title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Check posting date before posting (preview posting) in the sales and purchase documents – Customization
summary: This customization adds a validation to check if the posting date on sales and purchase documents matches the current month, displaying a confirmation dialog if it does not. It uses event subscribers on the Sales-Post and Purch.-Post codeunits to enforce this check before posting.
key_points: Event subscribers are used on codeunits 81 (Sales-Post) and 91 (Purch.-Post) to intercept posting operations
The customization checks if the posting date falls within the current month using CalcDate function
Both regular posting and preview posting scenarios are covered with appropriate events
A confirmation dialog prompts the user to proceed if the posting date is outside the current month
This approach can be extended to add other custom validations like required field checks

quotes.text: This is just a simple example, you can also use the same method to add other controls, such as required fields, etc.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that this event subscriber pattern is reusable for implementing additional business rule validations
